title: Clitoris
summary: The clitoris is a sensitive sexual organ whose only known function is pleasure. Only the small glans is visible at the top of the vulva; most of it extends internally.
key_points: It has a very high concentration of nerve endings and is often very sensitive.
Many people with a vulva need clitoral stimulation to orgasm; penetration alone often isn't enough.
It swells with blood during arousal, similar to an erection.
answer_guidance: Keep it factual and normalising. It's fine to mention that clitoral stimulation matters for pleasure if asked.
